blocks.html: When the GRG is ready, export it as a file or send it straight to your team.

slides.title: Export the GRG
slides.html: Select the Export icon and choose Export as KMZ or Export as JSON. The file is saved to Documents > WinTAK > Export by default.

slides.title: Send a GRG & set preferences
slides.html:
If you exported as JSON, select Send GRG on the GRG Builder panel to send it to contacts.

  • To clear everything placed this session, use Delete at the top of the panel.
  • Configure Auto Import GRG, the JSON directory and Set GRG Spacing Intervals under Edit GRG > Edit GRG Components > Open Preferences.
